subject: Veridian Health — security triage & deployment route confirmation
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call triage: Veridian Health — deployment route & evidence asks

Team — quick recap and triage after the discovery with Alex (Veridian sec/ec2 lead):

Call summary (10m):
- Use case: PHI-bearing clinical summarization and care-coordination (real-time requests from their EHR).
- Preference: They said Dedicated capacity would be ideal for predictable throughput, but the security team is pushing for Private VPC/on-prem if we can’t meet audit evidence for PHI.
- Must-haves from them: signed BAA, SOC 2 Type II report, network topology diagram showing isolation, KMS/HSM controls, retention policy for logs and prompts, and penetration test evidence.

Immediate asks for us (owner in parentheses):
1) Confirm we can sign a standard BAA and provide our SOC 2 Type II report (Marissa).
2) Produce a draft network diagram and data flow for both Dedicated and Private VPC options (Olga).
3) Short feasibility note on timeline and cost delta: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (Karthik).
4) Prepare a minimal evidence packet to share with Veridian security: certs, summary of encryption-at-rest/in-transit, KMS approach, recent pentest statement (Marissa).

Notes/constraints:
- If Veridian requires on-prem air-gapped, that becomes a bespoke engagement with lead time (estimate 8+ weeks).
- Dedicated + strict tenancy + customer-managed VPC peering could be a middle ground — likely acceptable if we can produce the architecture and confirm logs/retention meet their audit.

Next steps (owner + ETA):
- Marissa: SOC2 cert + evidence packet draft — EOD Fri 11 Jun.
- Olga: network/dataflow diagrams for Dedicated and Private VPC — TUE 15 Jun.
- Karthik: cost/time delta note and rollout checklist (canary, fallback to hosted) — Mon 14 Jun.
- Grace: consolidate and send initial response to Alex with questions asking for expected RPS, retention window, and whether they need access to raw logs or just aggregated metrics — Fri 11 Jun morning.

Attachments: Veridian_RFP_Snippet.pdf (from their procurement email) referenced on the call.

Thanks — small, tactical set of asks so we can keep the deal moving.

— Grace

Wiring in a few facts — I can own the SOC2/BAA packet. Quick clarifications: 
- We can sign a standard BAA for PHI; legal prefers the standard wording we use for other health customers.
- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) is available; I'll extract the public summary and the auditor's letter for them.
- We can provide a pentest statement and a redacted pentest summary (full report goes through DPA process).

High-level timing: I can have the evidence packet + SOC2 summary ready by EOD Fri 11 Jun. For Private VPC/on-prem, expect a longer timeline: internal procurement + infra prep is likely 6–8 weeks from kickoff (assuming no network constraints).

Note on ask: We should ask Alex whether Veridian requires continuous access to raw request logs or if an aggregated telemetry export is sufficient for their audit — that affects both retention and data sharing agreements.

I'll start drafting the packet now and will share a Google Drive link when ready.

— Marissa

Subject: Re: Post-call triage: Veridian Health — deployment route & evidence asks

Couple of technical notes to include in the packet and questions for the security team: 

1) Dedicated option (recommended first pass):
- Logical tenancy with isolated GPU pool, private peering option into Veridian VPC, encrypted tunnels.
- We can enforce no-request-logging to persistent storage by default; optional request logging can be turned on per customer for troubleshooting with retention controls.
- KV cache and batching optimizations won't surface PHI to any shared caches if we enable per-tenant cache isolation.
- Timeline: ~2–3 weeks to provision Dedicated capacity and validate routing + TLS endpoints.

2) Private VPC / On-prem:
- Full network isolation, customer-managed peering, and KMS integration (bring-your-own-key via HSM or cloud KMS).
- Longer lead (6–8 weeks) because networking approvals and a different packaging model are required.

3) Evidence pack items I can produce:
- Example network topology for Dedicated and Private VPC (diagram + legend).
- Endpoint TLS cipher suites and cert rotation policy.
- KMS/HSM integration note and sample config (redacted).
- List of logs/telemetry that we retain by default and adjustable retention windows.

Questions for Alex (to include in the email):
- Expected sustained and peak RPS / avg sequence length (tokens) — impacts Dedicated sizing.
- Retention window required for prompts & responses and whether raw prompts must be stored for auditing.
- Do they require PCI-level segregation or just HIPAA BAA controls?

I'll draft the diagrams and a short tech memo and drop links into Marissa's packet.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Follow-up & ask: Veridian deployment options and evidence (BAA, SOC2, diagrams)

Alex — thanks again for the call. Quick follow-up and a short list of items we can provide to speed your security review.

What Redwood can provide now:
- Signed BAA (standard template) and SOC 2 Type II summary (latest 12 months).
- Redacted pentest summary and statement of remediation scope.
- Architecture sketches for two options: Dedicated (isolated GPU pool + private peering) and Private VPC (full customer-managed peering / KMS).
- KMS/HSM options and encryption-at-rest/in-transit descriptions.

Questions for you (so we size & prepare the right evidence):
1) Expected sustained RPS and expected average tokens per request (this will feed Dedicated sizing).
2) Retention window for request logs / whether raw prompts must be retained for audit.
3) Any specific compliance docs beyond BAA and SOC2 (e.g., state-level HITRUST, PCI) we should plan for?

Immediate next steps:
- We will send an evidence packet (SOC2 summary + pentest statement + draft diagrams) by close of day today (Marissa / Olga).
- Once you confirm sizing and retention, Karthik will follow up with a timeline and cost delta for Dedicated vs Private VPC.

If helpful, we're happy to set a 30-minute technical deep-dive with Olga and your infra lead next week to walk through the diagrams.

Appreciate the quick feedback — I want to keep this moving toward a clear path (Dedicated first, Private VPC as fallback if audit requires).

Best,
